name: zimlo
description: Agent-authored progress Feed and action checkpoints for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Publish meaningful coding checkpoints to your local Feed.
interface.longDescription: Adds the Zimlo Feed protocol, MCP tools, and lifecycle checkpoints to Codex GUI tasks. Agents author posts explicitly; Zimlo stores and displays them without scraping logs or generating summaries.
defaultPrompt: Start this coding task and keep Zimlo updated at meaningful checkpoints.
Post the current result to my Zimlo Feed.
Explain what is blocking this task and ask me through Zimlo.
